newsitem.title: USA: El Paso refinancing realizes $400 mln.
newsitem.headline: El Paso refinancing realizes $400 mln.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said it will realize about $400 million from refinancing of the Australian natural gas pipeline owned Tenneco Energy, which El Paso acquired from Tenneco Inc December 12.
The company said a partnership with Consolidated Natural Gas Co, announced November 14, will operate Epic Energy Pty Ltd, which will be owned by a partnership formed Wednesday.

The partnership is owned 30 percent each by El Paso and CNG, and 10 percent each by four Australian investors -- Allgas Energy Ltd, AMP Investments, Axiom Funds Management and Hastings Funds Management.
When the partnership was formed, an El Paso spokeswoman said, it took on Tenneco Australian's debt, leaving Epic with a 70-30 debt/equity ratio.
El Paso's statement said the partnership values the pipeline assets at more than $500 million in Australian dollars.

The assets include two long-distance natural gas pipelines from Australia's Cooper Basin. One carries natural gas from the city of Moomba south to Adelaide. The other was recently built and will carry natural gas from the city of Ballera east to Wallumbilla, Queensland.
